stories.t: Twelve arrested for allegedly running cat trafficking ring in Vietnam
stories.s: The men are accused of stealing around 2,700 cats in Ho Chi Minh City, allegedly to be slaughtered for food.

stories.t: What China's new military foothold in Laos means for Southeast Asia
stories.s: Beijing says its new Laos facility will train pilots. Analysts see a broader signal: China's growing military presence in mainland Southeast Asia.
stories.tz: 中国在老挝建立新的军事据点对东南亚意味着什么
stories.sz: 北京方面表示，其在老挝的新设施将用于培训飞行员。分析人士则看到了一个更广泛的信号：中国在东南亚大陆日益增长的军事存在。

stories.t: Drones buzz overhead, troops hunker underground in Ukraine's hellish kill zone
stories.s: The front line in the Russia-Ukraine war stretches more than 700 miles and has barely moved in four years. Yet straddling this line is the kill zone, dominated by constantly evolving drone technology.

stories.t: Suspected pneumonic plague in Siberia: What we know about the disease
stories.s: A worker at a plague research institute in Siberia has died, and nearly 200 of her contacts are under medical observation. Russian authorities deny a link to the bacterial infection. The US is monitoring the situation.

stories.sz: 西伯利亚一家鼠疫研究所的一名工作人员已经死亡，近200名密切接触者正在接受医学观察。俄罗斯当局否认这与细菌感染有关。美国正在密切关注局势。

stories.t: Bosnia election: New steps to prevent electoral fraud, but nationalist parties remain on top
stories.s: New technology has stopped votes being cast on behalf of dead or absent voters, and turnout has fallen to a record low. But it was a case of deja vu in Bosnia's elections with the same parties winning.
stories.tz: 波黑选举：采取新措施防止选举舞弊，但民族主义政党依然占主导
stories.sz: 新技术阻止了冒用已故或缺席选民名义的投票，投票率降至历史最低点。但波黑选举结果似曾相识，依然是相同的政党获胜。

stories.t: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests
stories.s: Sánchez says Spain will head to the polls on 29 November after recent defeats on measures aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis.

stories.sz: 桑切斯表示，在近期旨在解决该国住房危机的事项遭遇挫折后，西班牙将于11月29日举行大选。

stories.sz: 一份报告显示，超过三分之一的以色列人表现出心理健康状况不佳的症状。在“10·7”袭击发生三年后，该国的医疗卫生系统仍在努力应对其带来的影响。
